definitions.explanation: A person who aspires to or applies for a particular position, school, course, or opportunity.

examples.japanese: {志望者|しぼうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{増|ふ}えている→増える：01183_fueru⟧。
examples.english: The number of applicants is increasing.

examples.japanese: ⟦{医学部|いがくぶ}→医学部：27620_igakubu⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧{志望者|しぼうしゃ}⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{毎年|まいとし}→毎年：00731_maitoshi⟧⟦{多|おお}い→多い：01127_ooi⟧。
examples.english: There are many applicants to the medical school every year.

examples.japanese: ⟦{今年|ことし}→今年：00722_kotoshi⟧⟦は→は：00079_ha⟧⟦{採用|さいよう}→採用：04563_saiyou⟧{志望者|しぼうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{定員|ていいん}→定員：04532_teiin⟧⟦の→の：09472_no⟧⟦{三|さん}{倍|ばい}→三倍：28459_sanbai⟧⟦に→に：00314_ni⟧⟦{達|たっ}した→達する：02129_tassuru⟧。
examples.english: This year, the number of job applicants reached three times the available positions.

notes:
USAGE:
{志望者|しぼうしゃ} is a compound of ⟦{志望|しぼう}→志望：03200_shibou⟧ (aspiration, wish) and ⟦{者|しゃ}→〜者：04662_sha⟧ (person). It emphasizes the person's own desire or ambition, distinguishing it from ⟦{応募者|おうぼしゃ}→応募者：20440_oubosha⟧ (someone who has formally applied) or {受験者|じゅけんしゃ} (someone who takes an exam).

COMMON COLLOCATIONS:
- ⟦{入学|にゅうがく}→入学：02092_nyuugaku⟧{志望者|しぼうしゃ} (applicant for admission)
- ⟦{就職|しゅうしょく}→就職：03209_shuushoku⟧{志望者|しぼうしゃ} (job seeker)
- {志望者|しぼうしゃ}⟦{数|すう}→数：03360_suu⟧ (number of applicants)
- {志望者|しぼうしゃ}⟦が→が：00051_ga⟧⟦{殺到|さっとう}→殺到：15036_sattou⟧⟦する→する：00392_suru⟧ (applicants flood in)
